See it in action

Inside the software

A look at the actual tools your team uses every day — from the pattern engine to layer-by-layer build maps.

Pattern Engine

50+ optimized patterns, instantly

Enter your case and pallet dimensions and Betsel Stack instantly generates dozens of layouts — each ranked by cubic efficiency, case support, and stability. You start from the best option, not a blank screen.

Why it matters — Stop guessing at Ti-Hi. See the most efficient, most stable pattern for your exact case in seconds.
Layer Planning

Plan every layer, down to the case

Step through the load one layer at a time — including alternating and interlocked layers — with exact case placement, orientation, and dimensions called out.

Why it matters — Gives your crew a clear, repeatable build map and fewer mistakes on the floor.
Mixed-Case Loads

Multiple case sizes on one pallet

Real shipments are not one SKU. Combine different cases and box sizes, layer by layer, and see the finished unit load rendered in full 3D.

Why it matters — Build and document accurate mixed loads that match what actually ships.
Trailer Loading

Fill the trailer, keep it balanced

Plan how pallets fit a 53′ reefer, dry van, or custom trailer — with live pallet counts, column-and-row layout, and a center-of-mass balance check.

Why it matters — Maximize every trailer and cut freight cost per unit shipped.
Professional Output

Export print-ready engineering reports

Compose a custom report from 3D renders, 2D layer diagrams, and case, pallet, and truck stats — then export a polished, branded Pallet Pattern Engineering Report with dimensions, cubic efficiency, support, stability, weight breakdowns, and truck loading. Ready to print, email, or export to Excel.

Why it matters — Look professional, keep specs on file, and give every job a documented paper trail.
